verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own APIs for managing connections, transformations and other features programmatically, plus an API for triggering Reverse ETL syncs. That is a first-party headless control surface suitable for automation. Profiles are declared in version-controlled YAML, which fits a code-driven workflow, but no CLI or CI integration is explicitly documented, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/CD usage (e.g. GitHub Actions), headless deployment workflows for transformations and tracking plans, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
